# Prezi Knowledge Document

## 1. High-Level Introduction

Prezi is an AI-powered virtual presentation platform designed to create more engaging, persuasive, and memorable presentations compared to traditional slide-based formats. Its core innovation is an open, non-linear canvas that allows presenters to zoom and pan between topics, creating a dynamic and cinematic experience. Prezi is built for a wide range of users, including business professionals, educators, and students, who want to move beyond static slides to meaningfully engage their audiences. The platform's primary goal is to solve the problem of audience disengagement by transforming presentations into compelling visual stories, made faster and more accessible through cutting-edge AI technology.

## 2. Core Products & Features

Prezi's features are designed to streamline creation and maximize audience impact.

### a. Prezi AI

Prezi AI is the intelligent engine that automates and enhances the presentation creation process, allowing users to focus on their message rather than design.

*   **AI Presentation Generator:** Users can generate a complete, well-structured presentation in minutes simply by providing a text prompt or an idea. The AI handles the outline, content suggestions, and initial design.
    *   **Benefit:** This drastically reduces preparation time, overcomes the "blank page" problem, and provides a professional starting point for any topic.
*   **Content Transformation:** Prezi AI can import existing content from PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF, or Word (.docx) files and automatically convert it into a dynamic Prezi presentation.
    *   **Benefit:** This allows users to easily modernize their existing materials and transition to Prezi without starting from scratch.
*   **AI-Assisted Design & Editing:** The AI provides personalized recommendations for layouts, color palettes, and visuals tailored to the user's content. It can also rewrite, shorten, lengthen, or simplify text with a single click.
    *   **Benefit:** Empowers users without design skills to create visually stunning, on-brand presentations and refine their messaging for maximum clarity and impact.
*   **AI-Powered Templates:** A library of professionally designed templates that automatically structure and visualize content generated by the AI, suitable for various use cases like business reports, lesson plans, and timelines.
    *   **Benefit:** Provides a polished, expert-designed foundation that ensures presentations are both beautiful and effective.

### b. Prezi Present

The core presentation editor and experience that sets Prezi apart from linear slide decks.

*   **Conversational Open Canvas:** Unlike traditional slides, Prezi uses a single, zoomable canvas. This allows presenters to reveal information dynamically, showing the relationship between the big picture and the details.
    *   **Benefit:** This format is proven to be more engaging and memorable. An independent university study found Prezi to be 25% more effective and 40% more memorable than PowerPoint.
*   **Flexible Navigation:** Presenters can move freely around the canvas, allowing them to jump directly to topics the audience is most interested in.
    *   **Benefit:** This transforms a monologue into a conversation, making presentations more interactive and responsive to audience needs.
*   **Rich Media Library:** Includes access to over 1 million images, GIFs, icons, and other assets to visualize any idea.
    *   **Benefit:** Users can easily find the perfect visual to illustrate their points, making the presentation more vivid and understandable.

### c. Prezi Video

A tool designed for the modern era of virtual and hybrid communication.

*   **Presenter & Content On-Screen:** Prezi Video overlays the presenter's video feed directly onto their presentation content, so they appear alongside their visuals.
    *   **Benefit:** This maintains a crucial human connection in remote settings, preventing the presenter from becoming a disembodied voice. It is ideal for virtual sales pitches, online classes, and recorded training sessions.
*   **Integration with Conferencing Tools:** Works seamlessly with popular video conferencing platforms like Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet.
    *   **Benefit:** Elevates standard video calls into professional, engaging virtual presentations.
*   **Record and Share:** Users can record their presentations as video files to be saved and shared asynchronously.
    *   **Benefit:** Perfect for creating flipped classroom content, on-demand training modules, or sales follow-ups that can be viewed anytime.

## 3. Solutions by Audience & Use Case

Prezi provides tailored solutions that address the specific pain points of different user groups.

### a. For Business Professionals (Sales, Marketing, Training, HR)

Prezi helps business teams create standout content that drives results, from winning new clients to training employees effectively.

*   **Pain Point: Creating compelling presentations takes too much time.**
    *   **Solution:** Prezi AI generates sales pitches, marketing strategies, project proposals, and business reviews in seconds from a simple prompt or an existing document, freeing up time for high-value work.
*   **Pain Point: Audiences are disengaged by standard, boring slide decks.**
    *   **Solution:** Prezi's dynamic, cinematic format captures and holds attention. According to a survey, 4 out of 5 professionals say Prezi is more effective at capturing audience attention, and 91% report it has positively improved their work outcomes.
*   **Pain Point: Maintaining brand consistency across the team is difficult.**
    *   **Solution:** Users can upload a company logo, and Prezi AI will automatically create on-brand color palettes. Prezi for Teams offers centralized control and shared templates to ensure consistency.
*   **Pain Point: Connecting with audiences in virtual meetings is challenging.**
    *   **Solution:** Prezi Video puts the presenter and their content together on screen, making virtual presentations more personal and engaging. This is highly effective for remote sales demos and company-wide trainings.

### b. For Educators and Administrators

Prezi empowers educators to create captivating lessons that improve student engagement and learning retention.

*   **Pain Point: Students easily lose focus during lectures.**
    *   **Solution:** Preziâs visual storytelling and cinematic movement turn lessons into engaging narratives. A survey of over 1,300 educators revealed that 82% report better student engagement when using Prezi.
*   **Pain Point: Limited time for lesson preparation.**
    *   **Solution:** With Prezi AI, educators can generate a class-ready lecture from a simple prompt (e.g., "Create a lesson on the periodic table"). The same survey showed that 2 out of 3 educators saved over 30 minutes preparing lessons.
*   **Pain Point: Adapting to remote, hybrid, or flipped classroom models.**
    *   **Solution:** Prezi Video is ideal for recording lessons where the teacher remains visually present alongside the material. The platform works seamlessly on Chromebooks, iPads, and Smartboards.
*   **Pain Point (Administrators): Equipping staff with effective teaching tools.**
    *   **Solution:** Prezi for Teams offers a school-wide solution that helps teachers, students, and departments collaborate and communicate more effectively, with dedicated support.

### c. For Students

Prezi helps students create polished, high-impact presentations that stand out and achieve better academic results without the stress.

*   **Pain Point: The pressure of creating high-quality presentations for grades.**
    *   **Solution:** Prezi AI helps students build A+ content from an idea or outline in seconds, transforming static research into an interactive narrative. A student survey found 95% found Prezi AI helpful for schoolwork.
*   **Pain Point: Lack of professional design skills.**
    *   **Solution:** Prezi AI acts as a personal designer, suggesting layouts, visuals, and text improvements, ensuring every presentation looks polished and professional.
*   **Pain Point: The "all-nighter" spent on assignments.**
    *   **Solution:** By automating the most time-consuming parts of presentation creation, Prezi helps students work more efficiently. 4 out of 5 students reported saving 30+ minutes on school work. As one student, Aleasha L., noted, "I got an A+ with prezi and a B with powerpoint" for the same presentation content.

## 5. Company & Platform Information

*   **Mission:** "We help people meaningfully engage their audiences."
*   **History:** Founded in 2009, with over 15 years of experience in visual storytelling.
*   **Leadership:**
    *   Jim Szafranski, CEO
    *   Peter Arvai, Executive Chairman and Co-founder
    *   Adam Somlai-Fischer, Principal Artist & Co-founder
*   **Company Values:** Take ownership and accountability; Move fast and trust teamwork; Be direct and show care.
*   **Platform Capabilities:**
    *   **Security:** SOC 2 compliant, ensuring data is safe and secure.
    *   **Offline Access:** The Prezi for Desktop app allows users to edit and present without an internet connection.
    *   **Presenter Tools:** Features Presenter View with notes and a timer.
    *   **Analytics:** Provides insights into viewer engagement on shared presentations.
    *   **Privacy Controls:** Granular control over who can view, edit, and comment on presentations.

## 6. Pricing & Plans

Prezi offers various plans tailored to different user needs. While specific pricing is not detailed, the structure includes:

*   **Free Trial:** Users can get started and try Prezi for free.
*   **Student Plans:** Significant discounts are available for students, with offers of up to 80% off.
*   **Individual Plans:** Designed for individual professionals and creators.
*   **Prezi for Teams:** A comprehensive business solution that includes advanced collaboration features, brand management, and dedicated support for corporate teams and educational institutions.
